samples.identity: Obfuscated cleaner XAPK with unresolved opaque assets
evidence: The outer XAPK contains base and ARM64 configuration APKs and seven application DEX files.
Inspected first-party code implements cleaner UI, advertising/configuration traffic and obfuscated strings.
Both inspected component-setting calls use state 1, which enables a component.
The classloader-hijack finding combined unrelated runtime/reflection references from advertising SDKs.
The account-store hit was merely /data/system/users/ in libweapon.so, without an account database filename.
limitations: Several large opaque assets and native SDK payloads could not be fully recovered statically; their contents prevent a confident benign ruling.
No hostile behavior was established by the former classloader or broad-directory matches.

evidence: RegisterPhoneActivity starts a repeating gallery collector.
AppShell recursively scans public DCIM, Pictures, Downloads and Documents directories.
TextRecognitionService filters OCR for mnemonic and 助记词.
hudhp posts matching images, recognized text, device identifier and install date.
limitations: Generalized OCR/photo upload detection now matches the original DEX; one hostile finding, not three padded variants.

samples.identity: Payment-card NFC relay with deceptive verification UI
evidence: IsoDep.transceive implements payment-card APDU exchange.
Raw card data is published through CARD_INFO_CHANNEL to an external WebSocket.
Local HTML asks for a four- or six-digit PIN under a card-protection verification pretext.
limitations: PIN is put into local URL history; this review did not prove that the PIN itself leaves the device.
One existing hostile card-relay/exfiltration finding remains.

samples.identity: Financial WebView wrapper carrying the covert agent
evidence: The wrapper presents MorganArg financial WebView content and installs assets/app-release.apk.
That embedded APK is byte-identical to db7a1c352c7d1ac75e0ba31b71cf4b0e3304a22b8d0d636fa80b5d5095be1e00.
limitations: The wrapper inherits the embedded agent findings; independent wrapper and child evidence were reviewed separately.

evidence: MainActivity.initializeLogic passes /data/, /sys/ and /system/ to FileUtil.deleteFile.
The helper walks directories recursively and calls java.io.File.delete.
AppLock interferes with foreground apps and shows a hacked message.

samples.identity: Voice changer containing encrypted billing payload
evidence: The string decoder was reimplemented as integer operations without executing specimen code.
assets/kdcnbw decrypts with embedded AES-CBC key/IV to a ZIP containing loader.dex and kernel.dex.
The loader impersonates com.microsoft.appcenter.Client and reflectively initializes needle.kernel.Needle.
The kernel obtains remote offers, handles shortcode/keyword/IVR offer policy and launches ACTION_CALL with a remotely supplied tel: destination.
limitations: Original APK automatic findings remain inadequate: static decryption was manual.
The extractor does not automatically decode arbitrary custom string decryptors or recursively decrypt their assets.

samples.identity: QR scanner with remote-controlled raw scan uploads
evidence: The alleged Wi-Fi-disable call actually passes true to setWifiEnabled; it configures a scanned Wi-Fi network.
A Firebase Remote Config switch gates collection of scanned SMS/text content.
utility.q.o0 and q.Z append the raw scanned content into language-keyed Firestore documents.
A notification-listener service is named in the manifest, but its implementation was not found in the DEX files.
limitations: No implemented notification/SMS-inbox interception or premium-billing route was established.
Server-side use of uploaded scan contents is unavailable; this limits the abuse determination, rather than proving a toll-fraud family.

samples.identity: APKPure client with an injected encrypted module loader
evidence: An injected com.main package implements Base64/repeating-XOR decoding and reflective DexClassLoader construction.
Decoded embedded data contains a ZIP with an 80452-byte DEX, entrypoint com.bb.s2x2e.go.AAA.
The embedded SDK persists its service, handles hidden/periodic offer routes and downloads additional code for reflective execution.
limitations: Original APK automatic hostile coverage remains missing for this custom multi-stage encoding.
APKPure version 3.17.18 and valid vendor signing do not make the embedded payload benign.

evidence: Google services branding conceals an app in com.google.android.bacfup.
Remote command dispatcher controls message, image, audio and device operations.
Implemented SMS, call-log and contacts collection is coupled to socket transport.
limitations: Two existing hostile message-exfiltration findings remain; additional hostile coverage was not fabricated.

samples.identity: Covert VNC derivative with unlock-pattern capture
evidence: LockScreenDetector recognizes Android keyguard and pattern views, then starts touch recording.
InputRecordingManager collects and uploads gestures and screenshots.
AppProtectionDetector locates uninstall and accessibility controls and covers their rectangles with overlays.
Privacy-scene handling suppresses display, sounds and haptic feedback while remote control runs.
limitations: New parsed-call rules expose keyguard/touch capture and installer-control cooccurrence as suspicious.
Automatic hostile coverage for the full cross-method credential and covert-control chains remains incomplete.

coverage_note: Manual ruling and automatic detection are recorded separately. Bad rulings do not imply that automatic hostile coverage is complete; no extra hostile variants were added solely to reach the preferred count.
changes: Added bounded, non-executing DEX imports/functions/calls and literal argument propagation in sibling filefacts.
Added argument-specific Wi-Fi and Android component state findings; enabling calls no longer imply disabling.
Added a data/system-root wipe finding requiring deletion targets and directory deletion mechanics.
Added mnemonic-targeted image OCR/POST detection with English and Chinese controls.
Retired generic OkHttp/opaque-asset coincidences and relocated runtime/classloader name cooccurrences to neutral metadata.
Narrowed Android account path evidence to database filenames; the broad per-user directory is no longer suspicious account theft.
Moved mnemonic terminology to literal metadata and updated consumers.
